mapper.select:
SELECT n.notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_content, n.notice_type, n.send_time, nu.is_read AS read_state, nu.read_time
ORDER BY n.order_num ASC, n.send_time DESC, n.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice_user nu INNER JOIN sys_notice n ON n.notice_id = nu.notice_id SET nu.is_read = 1, nu.read_time = NOW() WHERE nu.user_id = #{userId} AND nu.is_del = 0 AND nu.is_read = 0 AND n.is_del = 0 AND n.is_send = 1 AND (n.expire_time IS NULL OR n.expire_time > NOW())

UPDATE sys_notice_user nu INNER JOIN sys_notice n ON n.notice_id = nu.notice_id SET nu.is_read = 1, nu.read_time = NOW() WHERE nu.user_id = #{userId} AND nu.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND nu.is_del = 0 AND nu.is_read = 0 AND n.is_del = 0 AND n.is_send = 1 AND (n.expire_time IS NULL OR n.expire_time > NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN nu.is_read = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS read_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN nu.is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unread_count FROM sys_notice_user nu WHERE nu.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND nu.is_del = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice_user SET is_del = 1 WHERE is_del = 0 AND is_read = 1 AND ( (read_time IS NOT NULL AND read_time < #{deadline}) OR (read_time IS NULL AND create_time < #{deadline}) )
UPDATE sys_notice_user SET is_del = 1 WHERE is_del = 0 AND is_read = 0 AND create_time < #{deadline}
